It makes me look and feel younger. It's very lightweight on my face. The milk drops also leave my face smooth and bright.
I have dry and sensitive skin. This soothes and hydrates my skin. It's perfect under my makeup. I look glowy and beautiful. It doesn't irritate my skin at all.

avis.titre: Adds a layer of moisture to plump skin

I went to Ulta to look around for a good skin care, routine product, and the woman that works there tried this product on my hand, convincing me to buy it and how it would help hydrate my face. The first two days was fine, but the next couple days this product has caused my face, redness and swelling. I never had chemical burn from any products beforeso i was very upset. Any other products from Beekman works better but not this serum. I suggest if you have sensitive skin or acne or using any other acne cleaning prouduct please do not use or buy this product.
I really really wanted to love this product but it broke me out. I used 4x wanting to believe in it my skin got worse. more breakouts.
I am obsessed. My skin loves them and drank them up. Soothing and gentle, hydrates my skin, does not irritate. Will buy again.

I love this product I'm on my second jar its amazing i use it as my forst step after cleansing before moisturizer!

avis.titre: A little bottle that does big wonders.

However, after seeing the results, Milk Drops made me realize it really worths each buck.

I got this as a gift with purchase, but will definitly be ordering it when I'm out. It does have a little bit of a weird smell to me, but it's not bothersome. I have dry skin and this has been a great addition to my skin care regimen to help my skin be bright and hydrated.
Very hygienic design, drip on back of hand so it never touches skin! Very silky, no scent, and absorbed quickly so it was ready for next product.
I got this one as a gift with the purchase of Milk Shake. My skin looks fantastic!

i got this as a free birthday gift and i was excited to try it. i have sensitive acne prone skin and this left my face red, irritated and broken out :/ i tried multiple times using it and got the same result everytime

avis.titre: I have used this product for more than a year
avis.texte: I am 61 and love how this serum performs on my skin. I have tighter, softer skin with smaller pores. I have oily skin and this does not cause breakouts. Feels great and has a very mild scent - love Beekman and have used this entire line with great success.

This was the second time using this product. The first time it was fine. The second time it started burning within a few minutes. It was so hot and red. Horrible. I washed my face a few times and after 10-20 minutes it cooled down. Terrible product.

avis.titre: I would buy this product over and over
avis.texte: I have tried so many different dupes pf this product, and nothing is the same. I just keep coming back to this one. I don't know how, but it truly gives results overnight. My skin is so clear and my pores are invisible. I cannot recommend this more.
This is worth the splurge. My skin is very soft, it is my go to product and the only thing I use on my skin after I was my face with the Beekman face wash. I recommend to everyone.

Wow! I cannot explain how much I love this! I do not have sensitive skin. I do not have breakouts. I have combo skin, and this has made my skin even more amazing. It seems more evenly hydrated without being greasy/heavy. I use it after washing and before applying my moisturizer. It has helped to smooth my skin even more.
My skin changes with the weather - sometimes it's great, sometimes it's oily, and it's always sensitive. This serum handles all of that and makes my complexion look really really good.

At first I didn't think these drops were doing anything but I continued using them. After about 2 months my skin waa more hydrated, more plump and a lot softer. I will never be without these drops. You just have to be patient and give them time to work.

I have been using this serum at night with my retinol and it works wonderfully to keep my skin from getting too dry. I love its slimy texture that coats your skin and absorbs nicely. I will be repurchasing.
I absolutely love beekman products. I have sensitive skin and dry skin to boot. These products help with both. My face is soft and looks healthy. Thank u. Just wish u had sales every once on awhile.

I received this for my birthday and I absolutely love it! Its amazing on my skin (acne prone) and feels very moisturizing. My skin feels bouncy after applying. And i loveeee that all their products use goat milk, such s good ingredient. It is definitely pricey for the amount but it may be worth it.
I love it, it makes me glow and it is so soft and it alone, has been keeping my face clear.

I bought the set of 3, I put it in the order they recommend, as a product that is supposed to help improve the skin barrier can cause such irritation, my face is like a tomato and it burns me. Horrible!

I love this serum so much. I use it every morning after cleansing and exfoliating, then add my moisturizer on top. I'm really particular about the skin products I use, but this serum is great. My skin has genuinely never felt better. So worth it.

I've noticed a huge improvement on the texture and radiance of my skin. Go buy asap!!
I wanted to love this product but it made my skin burn and it turned red. Maybe it's because my skin is sensitive 🤷🏼‍♀️ Hopefully others have better luck
I wanted to love this product but it made my skin burn and it turned red. Maybe it's because my skin is sensitive 🤷🏼‍♀️ Hopefully others have better luck

avis.titre: Made face hot, red and irritated

Put on more aloe gel. Rinsed with cold water again after about 15 minutes. Skin slowly calmed down and the redness eventually went away for the most part. Never had a reaction like this, thankful it wasn't worse. Dont usually leave reviews but maybe it will save someone from this horrible experience. Got it has a free birthday gift, throwing it out. :(

I never react to any skincare but this inflames my face like no other. I thought it was my retinoid or azaelic acid but realized it's this after stopping my other products. It's likely the rose ingredient which is a known irritant and is the #2 ingredient here. I love beekman but not this! Going back to the other drops they offer

Both times I have tried this my face has immediately turned hot and red. Should not have tried it a second time!! I wonder what ingredient is in it that has caused this for some users. I do have sensitive skin but this is the worst my skin has ever reacted to a product.

Both times I have tried this my face has immediately turned hot and red. Should not have tried it a second time!! I wonder what ingredient is in it that has caused this for some users. I do have sensitive skin but this is the worst my skin has ever reacted to a product.
I've tried them all - high end and every end - this one is the best
Completely absorbs into skin, evens skin tone, adds a natural glow!

I got this as an ulta gift for my bday and i honestly love it. Its a very lightweight formula and instantly absorbs into your skin. No irritation or redness occured. Ive been using this for about a month and I have noticed a difference. my skin is more even, glowy and SOFT. I would definitely buy this again. ( I have combination skin)

This serum is great for anyone looking to start preventive anti-aging measures or anyone looking to build up their skins natural collagen. I mix a dropper of this serum in with my Bloom Cream moisturizer & it has lasted me for months. Truly the best anti-aging bang for your buck!

Generally love Beekman products and i got excited when this one was included in the 50% off sale. Its terrible! Wow! avis.titre: Bad reaction left me with welts

I did a patch test on my arm/hand to see which of the 3 products caused it, and the milk drops left a welt

Absolutely love this product! My 56 yo hyper-sensitive skin has never been softer, smoother, and more glowy. Skin barrier is thriving. Wears beautifully under makeup. Works fantastic alone or layers great with other skin care products. 100% addicted!

I used my birthday reward on this product, and I'm so disappointed. I went to put it on my face and I became curious. I too am a victim.. my face is slightly irritated and I didn't even have the product on for more than 2 minutes.
I got a little .5 sample for my birthday gift. So far I love it and it really softens my skin. I love running the back of finger on my face it feels so so smooth

avis.titre: I have rosacea and prone to eczema. This is great
avis.texte: I saw reviews tgat said that this product was bad for sensitive skin. I'm very sorry the girls had a bad experience, but as an eczema prone person with slight rosacea and sentive skin, this product didn't cause a reaction for me. It is very pleasant, not fragrant, the bottle feels luxurious, the effect is there. The only thing I'd say is that it dries a little sticky, but maybe it's what it is supposed to do. I'm thankful it was an option as a birthday gift, because now I'll consider looking at more products of this brand.

I have extremely dry and extremely sensitive skin (psoriasis and rosacea). I added this to my skincare routine after doing a training for the brand simply out of curiosity and I've received so many compliments on my skin since I started using it. My skin has not flared up as badly as it used to since I started using it. Absolutely 100% worth the price because my skin has never looked so good.

Something in this serum is incredibly irritating to my skin - and I don't have sensitive skin. It made my skin turned bright red immediately. It looks like a sunburn. Doesn't seem safe to use. What a waste…

Thanks Ulta for my lil birthday gift! Like other reviews.. I love it already! Wanted to try something different and im glad i did. I used a light gel cerave cleanser, followed by dermalogica superfoliant, toner, and then this amazing serum.. so so good!!!! Try it but be careful if you have sensitive skin. All products are not for everyone and that's ok - Ultas return policy is great!

I have been using this product for about a week now. I got it for my free birthday gift and I actually asked the cashier if to pick out one of the products she presented to me and this was what she chose! I am very pleased with her recommendation honestly. I was a bit scared to try it because I personally feel like I have sensitive skin but I could be wrong. With some of the reactions others have had I wasn't to sure but I decided to do a test patch on my cheek for the first time. No reaction , so I went ahead and did a full face. I had no bad reaction to it. I am just giving it a 4 star because I'm still hoping to see what noticeable benefits I'll get from this but my hopes are high! I do feel so far it is hydrating and with combining with another type of hydrating serum these two seem to be doing their best for me. I'll see how I feel after using the bottle completely if I decide to get purchase another & keep in my skin regimen. I'd say if you get this offered to you for a birthday gift try it while you don't have to buy it ☺️

I had this one before. I think I got it in my fit fab fun box once but I never used it. Years passed and I rediscovered it on my stash I was afraid to use it because it was most likely too old. When I was presented with the options of Birthday Gifts at the Ulta store last October I jumped on it, and told myself this time around I'd def try it. I have battled with patches of eczema on my face for years. I've tried everything and the only thing that helps is of course the medicated cream my Doctor prescribed, which is fine but I often forget to use it unless it starts bothering me. The eczema often leaves a "scar" behind, so it's annoying to have to use the medicated stuff even when I don't have a flare up to prevent it. But then! I tried this little miracle. It not only cleared the flare up in ONE DAY, regular daily use Prevents it from flaring up. Maybe it's the ceramides? I have no idea! But I love it!!!!! The price of the full size one is def steep for me but this baby last, so I think it will be totally worth it to invest on it once this sample is gone. I don't know about any other skin issues, I read some reviews saying I may not be good for rosacea, but if you have ECZEMA, especially on the side of the nose, chin, eyelids, I TOTALLY recommend it! Little miracle!!!!!!

I have been using this product for years. That's almost half the product missing. Either Beekman is shrinking the product, or Ulta messed up and is misrepresenting the item listing.

I'm still new to the product but so far so good. No issues with burning. My skin is looking healthier and brighter. However the biggest test will be on my hyper pigmentation. Also I have combination skin.

I love this product!! It has made my skin so soft and glowy again. I think a lot of the reviews about red patches must be allergic so definitely test it before using. Goats Milk has been my holy grail for my skin lately but it's sensitive for others!

I received this as a bday gift this year and fell inlove. I was able to seamlessly add it to my current routine and it has made my skin so soft. I hate how expensive it is but hoping i can buy during prestige coupon promos.

Ive never wrote a bad review about a product, but this one takes the cake. I applied it right after cleansing and instantly my face burns and leaves dry patches and red splotches all over my face. I highly don't recommend and it's not even a good texture when applying. I wish i could give this 0 stars and add a photo.

I usually do not switch up my skin care routine but one of the Ulta staff recommended to me for my birthday gift. I love it! There was some burning but only my dry areas and a little break out area i have. Other then that, I can totally notice the difference in my skin- very glowy and plump. Would definitely recommend.

avis.titre: Took my deep facial lines, crows feet and more in minutes!
avis.texte: I had a very deep line down the middle of my forehead that made me look angry all the time. I used this once and it took it mostly away. The second time I put it all over my face. My forehead line was gone! And it also took away my crows feet and lines around my mouth from smoking. Now I use it every three days to maintain the look. It has a squeeze dropper and it takes just a few drops to cover my entire face. I got the sample size for my birthday gift for being a rewards member. So I bought the big bottle. Would you believe that a full month later, I'm still using the sample up. Like I said, just a couple of drops at a time. You can always do another drop or two if you need it. And don't overdo it the first time. It takes a few times (days) to take everything away, so be patient. You will see a dramatic difference the first time!!!
I love that the serum has a milky consistency. It's hydrating and perfect for my skin

It was fine for a couple days but today it broke out my face and now I have to go to school like this. Definitely test it on your skin for a few days before fully putting it on because this IS NOT for sensitive skin.
I'm not entirely sure what this is doing for my skin but I do feel fancy putting this on my face. I wish it was either cheaper or we recieved more product because I feel like I ran out so fast.
I use this for my hands before bed and then my hand cream. They feel hydrated and plump after. Thanks Ulta for my birthday gift!

The only times its stung is when i used it on broken skin (like a picked acne spot or retinol dryness) but thats normal with all ceramides. Ive noticed my skin healing faster and feeling more evenly hydrated. A true blessing to my combination skin!! I will be buying a full sized version when i run out. Its surprising lasted a long time. I use about 1-2 drops on extra dry areas then spread the excess out.

Fellow Libra here as well who got this for a birthday reward and its AMAZING. Ive swapped out my serum for this in my skincare routine and its amazing. I see you Ulta!!! Giving me this for my birthday and now I love it and have to buy more hahaha I love this stuff. I don't use much stuff on my face, my face just prefers only water. For real, I don't "wash" my face because when I do I break out and I cant use much lotions or potions or anything. If i cannot find a dupe that works just as good i will be sacrificing just to buy this product over and over again.
For only the first application. My skin is looking great!! Give it a chance. I'm buying more right after this jar is done. Thank you Ulta for my amazing gift < 3

i got this for my birthday month gift and its SOO GOOD. it totally got rid of my blackheads on my nose and hydrates it so i dont even use extra products anymore. i think it has a certain ingredient in it that some people are allergic to but i was fjne and i have senstive skin. i have bad acne scares and i havent noticed a change in that. but still super good and tbh i kinda like the smell.

I got the sample size for my free birthday gift-I have no regrets! I love how it makes my skin feel, especially under my eyes/cheek area. It makes my skin so soft and I personally don't need to use a lot either. I just use small dabs here and there on the key points of my face then massage it in.
I use this every day as the first step after cleaning my skin. I never skip it. I have sensative skin which is normal to dry. My skin is balanced and brighter. I recommend giving it a try.

As someone sith rosacea and a very sensitive face, i have tried hundreds of products with mothing bug breakouts and rosacea flare-ups until i tried these milk drops. I have extremely senstive skin and got this as the birthday gift. I love it and will repurchase helped with redness and doesnt burn like most products do. Also has no fragrance and made my face super smooth and clear.

I will be carefully giving my birthday "gift" away. bummer.

I have dry skin.. and when applying it feels good and hydrating. BUT I'm bummed that it made me break out. I stopped using it and thought maybe it wasn't the product but it made me break out again after giving it another try.

avis.titre: Immediately irritated my skin + causes redness
avis.texte: Got this as the free birthday gift and it immediately irritated my skin and caused my whole face to get red. Not what you expect from a product that's meant to improve your skin barrier. I much prefer the ordinary's soothing & barrier support which is also a much cheaper product.

Keeps my skin hydrated the whole day! Not greasy and absorbs quickly

This product is not for people with Rosacea. I was very hyped about trying this product since it was recommended by an Ulta employee, and all it did was burn my cheeks immediately. It does seem to dry my skin out, so I have to follow with a moisturizer. I haven't really noticed a difference, but I've only been using for a couple of weeks. I don't notice a smell, like others have, and it goes on smooth.
These drops are so amazing. I absolutely will buy again. To everyone saying it smells like soured milk it's because it has goats milk in it y'all. The smell goes away in literally 60 seconds.

I wanted to really like this since I love goat milk products and use other Beekman products. Even getting milk drops 1/2 price, I feel like this product is way too expensive for the less than one ounce that you get. If the product worked great I would probably overlook the quantity However, after using the entire container, I didn't see any results. There are many other products that are more moisturizing and show better results.

My skin is definitely brighter, and no longer dull. It absorbs into my skin quickly, and a little goes a long way. My black heads are gone, and I'm extremely pleased with this item and entire skincare line.

This is a game-changer! My reactive, sensitive, oily skin is loving this for balancing moisture in warm, humid weather and priming before makeup. Ulta, you should bring back Geller, IMO. So many compliments!

I can see how people love this serum, but it is not for all skin types. As I am settling into my 30s my skin has changed from combo to dry. I do not have sensitive skin so I have not experienced the burning or redness that others mention. The dry down is fast so that helps when layering products. I have not experienced a strong fragrance, it smells like a typical fragrance free formula and smells like nothing once dried completely. With dry skin, once absorbed it leaves my face feeling tight wanting for more hydration.

I use this serum by itself directly on my face after toner and before my moisturizer, and it's become part of my daily routine. Although a bit drying, it's a great serum that dries quickly without leaving sticky residue.

I got this in sample size from a larger order I placed. I was excited to try it because the texture looked soothing and hydrating. Man was I wrong! I put it on after showering and my face turned soo red for hours. This kinda redness doesn't happen to me unless I'm doing chemical peels. Like what is in this product?! Do not recommend.

Turned my face red within the hour... no pain, no lasting rash, applied at night and nothing by morning. Gave to a friend who said it's lovely and will be added to routine. 3 stars because it worked so well for her.
This product has a bad smell and left me with a burning sensation had to quickly wash my face.

avis.titre: Caused me to break out and burning
avis.texte: I experienced breakouts all over my face as well as burning around my lips and nose. I love beekman products so this upset me!

I ciuldnt figure out why my makeup and moisturizer was pilling and finally figured out it was this serum. This is a sign it does not absorb into the skin well… not a fan especially trying to make my makeup go one with flaking off. May be better for oily skin

I love this stuff. I notice a huge difference if i forget to apply in the morning or if ive run out. Beekman has some great stuff. The scent is as bad as people say, but it does not last and is gone by the time you apply it. Just something to consider. I wonder if it goes off after opening / hitting air because the odor gets worse the longer you have the product. Worth the struggle.
This serum is absolutely doing wonders to my dry skin. It absorbs so fast into the skin. It doesnt linger like many serums or oils on the skin. It goes right in and helps with brightening the skin.

smells like sour goat milk. I know that goat milk is one of the key ingredients but the smell is so strong it makes me gag. I don't want to be walking around smelling like that....or having to smell that all day. also burned my face so bad.

avis.texte: I have very sensitive skin 0ily/ acne prone skin. Years of acne has left me with pitted scars and uneven skin texture. I have tried so many products that promised results and this one finally worked!!! My skin looks suble and the scars are less noticeable. An the best part I no longer look like a shiny disco ball. This product has helped with the oiliness that I have been plagued with my whole life. Please never stop making this product!!!!

avis.titre: Works But it Actually Does Burn My Skin
avis.texte: Typically I think that folks who complain about a product "burning" even though it's made for sensitive skin are exaggerating or there is something else wrong. Well, I stand corrected! My skin is just slightly sensitive and these Milk Drops burn! I'm very surprised. I also see some redness. On the other hand, it's not unbearable and my skin gets very soft so I'll put up with the temporary side effects. I'm very curious what they use in this product that causes the burning though.

Not sure if I just got a bad batch bc everyone seems to love this but I had an awful experience with this stuff. It is very drying and made my skin feel stiff and tight after I applied it. I started having multiple breakouts on both cheeks which is not normal for me & this made my normally dry skin a NIGHTMARE. I'm currently forced to slather Dermalogica on around the clock to repair my sensitized skin. It's a no for me, dawg.

Ran out of my usual serum and thought I'd give the sample a try. Applied half the sachet and it left my skin feeling tight and extremely dehydrated/dry. If you are working to remedy those skin concerns, pass over this product.

Left my skin feeling very soft, not so sure about "youthful" but i do sometimes have to deal with redness and fine lines. I got it during a sale and I would not hesitate to buy again if on sale. Tbh I could see myself buying 3 at a time.

I've purchased this stuff 4x now and i'm about to buy another one. I have the worse type of skin: hormonal adult acne, hyperpigmentation, sensitive, etc. but i have felt like this has helped calmed the redness and lessen my acne scarring. It did take me a good 2-3 consistent months to really see and feel the difference but I will forever be loyal to this serum as long as they're here!
This is the only serum I will use. It's simply the best - in every way.

I initially bought this when it was on sale and had to repurchase because it was that good. I see over all improvements in my skin texture and my skin tone appears more even. I have used a lot of serums (including Lancome, Estee Lauder, Korres, The Ordinary, Volition and others) and this one out performs for me. I haven't yet tried other products from Beekman, but they're on the list now!
